svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.one-sixth-region-selection", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Explore one64mm-diameter circular whole partitioned into6equal angular sectors. Exactly one entire sector is selected by an inset cluster of three graphic texture points. The same three-point cue is used across all denominators;its dot count/patch area is NOT the fractional value and it is not Braille. Count the equal regions and connect one selected region to the named unit fraction using physical models and language. All sectors have angle60.0degrees and area536.165146212658squaremm in the mathematical model. Shared centre junction is intentional. NativeIndex uses a10mm near-centre sampling guard,so physical continuity and the need for model/teacher support must be evaluated. No touch proofreading,learner recognition or source dimension recovery claimed.", "geometry_exception": "Swell/ViewPlus share1.4mm circle/radial boundaries and1.2mm inset selection points. NativeIndex uses1.2mm graphic dots with10mm centre/5.6mm perimeter-junction guards. All alternatives stay in same master;inset texture selects the whole sector,not its own area. No exact source reproduction.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots,notBraille. One common centre dot;10mm near-centre guard and5.6mm perimeter/radial junction guards avoid clusters. Three inset points select one entire sector. All-pairs clearance checked;actual tactile continuity remains pending.
